# Hay Where's That Inc. Blue Stuff 16 oz Antiseptic Lotion

Give your horse's skin targeted care with this antiseptic lotion, a barn staple for everyday wounds and irritations.

## Soothe Heel Scratches and Bleeding Heels

Within a few days, this lotion helps calm even the worst heel scratches and bleeding heels. Its antiseptic formula helps keep irritated areas clean while they heal.

## Care for Common Skin Irritations

Apply it to hopple burns, saddle sores, abrasions, and chafing to keep affected areas comfortable. You can also use it on facial skin irritations.

## Address Stubborn Fungus

Tired of battling leg fungus? This formula targets fungus on the legs and around the coronary band, helping you tackle a frustrating problem.

## Easy Application for Long-Haired Legs

For horses with long leg hair, wash the legs and towel dry, then apply the lotion to damp skin. Damp hair helps the lotion absorb more effectively than dry hair.

## Keep Your Barn Prepared

At 16 oz, this pint-size bottle fits easily into your first aid kit, so you always have a reliable option on hand. Add Hay Where's That Blue Stuff to your cart today and keep your horse's skin ready for whatever comes next.
